name: Snappy Chat Button
author: Snappy Plugins

sections.description:
Snappy Chat Button makes it effortless for visitors to reach you on WhatsApp. One click and they’re in a conversation with you. No forms, no email chains, no friction.

Install the plugin, enter your WhatsApp number, and a clean floating button appears on every page of your site. When a visitor clicks it, WhatsApp opens instantly. On mobile it launches the app, on desktop it opens WhatsApp Web, with a pre-filled message ready to go.

Features

  • 🌍 Country code dropdown – flag icons for every country, the plugin formats your number automatically
  • 💬 Pre-filled message – greet visitors with a custom opening message when WhatsApp opens
  • 🏷️ Button label – add text next to the icon, or leave it icon-only
  • 📍 Button position – place it bottom left, bottom centre, or bottom right
  • 📱 Mobile responsive – works on all screen sizes, all devices

Pro Version

Ready to take your button to the next level?

Snappy Chat Button Pro unlocks powerful customization and control features that help you get more from every visitor interaction.

  • 🎨 Custom button color and size
  • ⬜ Button shape and shadow control
  • 🚫 Hide on mobile, tablet, or desktop
  • ⏱️ Delay before button appears
  • 📄 Show only on specific pages
  • 📊 Click tracking and analytics
  • 💻 Custom CSS

Get Pro with a one-time payment at snappyplugins.gumroad.com. No subscription, no renewals.

Why Snappy?

  • Zero dependencies – no external APIs, no third-party services, no tracking
  • Lightweight – loads a single small CSS file on the front end
  • Privacy friendly – nothing is sent anywhere. Your data stays on your site
  • Works with any theme – compatible out of the box, no setup headaches

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings and click Snappy Chat Button
  4. Enter your WhatsApp number, set your message and label, choose a position, and click Save

Your button will appear on your site immediately.
sections.faq:
What number format should I use?

Select your country from the dropdown and enter your local number. The plugin handles all formatting automatically. No need to include the country code or leading zero.

Does this work on mobile?

Yes. On mobile and tablet it opens the WhatsApp app directly. On desktop it opens WhatsApp Web.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin loads a single small CSS file on the front end. No scripts, no external API calls, no database queries on page load.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The button is injected into the page footer and floats above your content using a high z-index.

Can I hide the button on certain pages or devices?

Page rules and device visibility are available in the Pro version at snappyplugins.gumroad.com.
